<description>
The IWYU invocation ends in `2>&1 || true`, added as a TODO when pipefail was introduced in fa99a3ccace. That `|| true` swallows the non-zero exit from a compiler `fatal error:` (for example a generated header that was not built before IWYU ran), so such errors only reached the raw CI logs and never failed the job, as reported in #35361.

Dropping the `|| true` lets pipefail propagate the failure, so the job fails loudly instead of passing silently. The recent header-generation fixes (#35468, #36228) mean the current master `iwyu` job is already free of such errors, so this does not turn CI red today.

Closes #35361.
</description>
